checklistSpecific: Confirm each script/routine in the toolkit is version-controlled with a change log
Confirm scripts are tested against a control dataset after any modification before reuse
Confirm the toolkit inventory records the owner, purpose and last-validated date for each script
Confirm deprecated scripts are archived rather than left available for accidental reuse
Confirm access to modify toolkit scripts is restricted to authorized analytics staff

testing.expected: Every script version-controlled with owner, purpose and last-validated date recorded

checklistGeneric: Confirm the profiling report is saved with owner and date
Confirm the item is cross-referenced to the applicable analytics workpaper
checklistSpecific: Confirm profiling covers record counts, field completeness, value distributions and key-field uniqueness
Confirm profiling results are compared against expectations from the process walkthrough
Confirm anomalies found in profiling (e.g., unexpected nulls, format inconsistencies) are documented
Confirm profiling is completed and reviewed before analytical test scripts are built on the dataset
Confirm the profiling summary is attached to the analytics workpaper

testing.expected: Profiling covers completeness, distributions and key-field uniqueness with anomalies documented

checklistGeneric: Confirm the communication record carries recipients and date
Confirm the underlying evidence is retained per the audit documentation retention policy
checklistSpecific: Confirm the insight summary translates technical analytics results into business-relevant risk language
Confirm insights delivered to engagement teams reference the underlying analytics workpaper
Confirm insights escalated to the Audit Committee are limited to those with material risk implications
Confirm stakeholder feedback on the usefulness of the analytics is captured for the toolkit backlog
Confirm the communication is logged with recipients and date

testing.expected: Insights communicated to engagement teams and, where material, to the Audit Committee

checklistGeneric: Confirm the run log is saved with owner and date
Confirm the status is reflected accurately in the audit management system
checklistSpecific: Confirm the population targeted is confirmed as high-risk per the current risk-ranking model
Confirm the routine executes on the defined schedule without manual intervention
Confirm exceptions generated are routed to a named triager within the agreed SLA
Confirm a sample of routine output is periodically re-verified manually to confirm the logic still holds
Confirm run logs are retained to evidence the monitoring operated continuously across the period

testing.location: Continuous monitoring run log, high-risk population
testing.expected: Routine executed on schedule with exceptions routed to a named triager within SLA

checklistGeneric: Confirm the run results are saved with owner and date
Confirm the item is cross-referenced to the applicable engagement or investigations record
checklistSpecific: Confirm the fraud-pattern routines target claims and payment data consistent with known fraud typologies
Confirm results are cross-checked against confirmed historical fraud cases to validate detection logic
Confirm flagged items are routed for triage with a documented disposition (true positive/false positive)
Confirm the analytics run covers the full period in scope, not a partial extract
Confirm findings from true-positive results are escalated to the relevant engagement or investigations team

testing.expected: Flagged items triaged and true positives escalated for follow-up

checklistGeneric: Confirm the triage log carries reviewer name and date
Confirm the status is reflected accurately in the audit management system
checklistSpecific: Confirm each exception is reviewed against source documentation to confirm it is a true finding versus a false positive
Confirm the disposition rationale for each exception is documented, not just a true/false tag
Confirm true-positive exceptions are carried forward into the finding-drafting workpaper
Confirm false-positive patterns are fed back to refine the analytics routine's logic
Confirm the triage log shows reviewer name and date for each disposition

testing.expected: Every exception dispositioned with documented rationale and reviewer sign-off

checklistGeneric: Confirm the benchmarking document is saved with owner and date

checklistGeneric: Confirm the communication record carries date and recipients

checklistGeneric: Confirm the self-assessment is saved with owner and date

checklistGeneric: Confirm the engagement file is saved with owner and date

checklistGeneric: Confirm the improvement plan is saved with owner and date
